title: How do I publish results publicly?
intent: This article explains how to make survey results publicly accessible via a web page.
short_answer: To publish results publicly, navigate to the Results page and use the 'Publish Results' option. You can publish individual contributions, statistics, charts, and uploaded documents. A public URL is generated where anyone (or password-protected access) can view the published results.
prerequisites: The user must be the survey owner
procedure: Navigate to the survey Results page.
Configure what to publish: contributions, statistics, charts, uploaded documents.
Optionally select which contributions to publish.
Optionally set a password for the publication page.
Share the publication URL with stakeholders.
important_conditions: You can publish all contributions or a filtered subset.
You can choose which questions are visible in the publication.
Statistics and charts can be included.
Publication can be enabled/disabled without deleting the configuration.
troubleshooting: Results not visible on publication page: Ensure the publication is active and at least one contribution is selected.
